cue_hierarchy.cue: Persistent peripheral-retina and selective-enlargement disclosure; vitreous-facing and choroidal-side orientation.

At most two simultaneously active directional overlays: pale dashed light arrows ILM toward receptor outer segments; orange solid qualitative neural-relay arrows toward GCL/NFL. Lateral feedback uses separate short two-way annotations.
Three opening callouts, then view-specific anatomy labels on demand. Original part material colors retained; selection cleared before judging pigmentation.
Thin annotation outline brackets explanatory cut edge; tissue window, global section, cut-away toggle and exploded separation are explicitly named distinct operations.

true_scale_policy.true_scale_claim: Authored nominal block reference mapping only; no claim that selectively enlarged structures have native dimensions.
true_scale_policy.nominal_specimen: 0.8 mm width; approximately 240 µm RPE-to-ILM depth per authored brief/common.py, not independently calibrated.
true_scale_policy.ruler: 400 µm/model unit, label: nominal block reference; selectively enlarged cells/interfaces are not morphometry
true_scale_policy.em_detail: No numeric EM magnification factor asserted without source-to-render calibration.
true_scale_policy.source_baseline_enlargement: Baseline metadata states selected representative cells X/Z enlarged 1.7× while Y laminar roles retained; delivered candidate adds selective detail and must not be described globally as uniformly 1.7×.
true_scale_policy.legacy_candidate_ruler: Existing candidate export viewer uses relative ruler (um_per_bu=0); new authored calibration requires deferred native/export loader assertions, not mesh rescaling.

retained_meaningful_baseline: 28 original exact selector identities and material/color groups
Peripheral regional identity and layered cutaway
Rod/cone distinction, radial Müller span and junctional OLM exemplars
Ganglion/NFL output relationship and separate retinal/choroidal vascular territories

deferred_checks: Each proposed preset applied to final saved part set without missing selector names.
Opening and reverse context framing at small viewport, selection clear, opaque mode and rotation.
Nuclear cores are shown with intended cellular envelopes; no orphan-dot view.
RPE apical relation and ganglion/NFL continuity visually reviewed after new build.
Thin membranes and vitreous do not obscure glial endfeet; rod detail remains hidden in overview.
Visibility partition and camera fitting rechecked after any geometry change.
Native and export readback preserve um_per_bu=400 and nominal-block-only ruler disclosure; original coordinates unchanged, no geometry rescaling.
